title: Contact Us, Campus Location, and Inquiry Desk
content: Apex Institute of Engineering & Technology, Knowledge City, Vidyanagari Campus, Sector 15. Phone: +91-22-28475000 / 5001. Email: admissions@apex.edu, info@apex.edu.
